newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 6-mo T-bills tranche yields avg 69.93 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia 6-mo T-bills tranche yields avg 69.93 pct.

text.p: A new 3.50 trillion rouble tranche of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills yielded an average 69.93 percent at auction on Wednesday, the Russian central bank said.
At the previous auction of six-month T-bills on August 21, the average yield was 74.16 percent.
The issue yielded an average 93.99 percent when it was first auctioned on July 24.
Full details of the issue follow.
Issue volume 3.50 trln rbls 7.50 trln rbls

The finance ministry is also offering 7.00 trillion roubles in new six-month T-bills at auction on Wednesday. It is also paying about 1.79 trillion roubles in interest on government bonds and repaying 4.52 trillion roubles in maturing six-month T-bills.

The finance ministry raised about 1.44 trillion roubles from selling two-year government bonds on the secondary market on Tuesday, and officials said this money would be used to pay bond interest today.
